québec ai institute, hec montréal, canada bin cui, peking university, china lei chen, hong kong university of science and technology, china graph neural networks (gnns) are a type of deep learning models that learning over graphs, and have been successfully applied in many domains. despite the effectiveness of gnns, it is still challenging for gnns to efficiently scale to large graphs. as a remedy, distributed computing becomes a promising solution of training large-scale gnns, since it is able to provide abundant computing resources. however, the dependency of graph structure increases the difficulty of achieving high-efficiency distributed gnn training, which suffers from the massive communication and workload imbalance. in recent years, many efforts have been made on distributed gnn training, and an array of training algorithms and systems have been proposed. yet, there is a lack of systematic review on the optimization techniques from graph processing to distributed execution. in this survey, we analyze three major challenges in distributed gnn training that are massive feature communication, the loss of model accuracy and workload imbalance. then we introduce a new taxonomy for the optimization techniques in distributed gnn training that address the above challenges. the new taxonomy classifies existing techniques into four categories that are gnn data partition, gnn batch generation, gnn execution model, and gnn communication protocol. we carefully discuss the techniques in each category. in the end
results.title: Distributed Graph Neural Network Training: A Survey

results.snippet: 论文地址:[2212.05410v1] ABC: Aggregation before Communication, a Communication Reduction Framework for Distributed Graph Neural Network Training and Effective Partition (arxiv.org) po主是一个小菜鸡,硕士毕业论文的研究方向是分布式gnn,这篇论文是副导的大作,本着看都看了就写篇笔记来总结的想法记录一下。我会尽量用平实的语言并且结合一些自己的理解,废话多说,下面开始进入正题。 众所周知,训练大图gnn是一个老难题了,因为去1:1还原现实生活中的web-scale graph是prohibitive的。(prohibitive一般被翻译为禁止的,但在这里也可以是高昂得令人难以承受的)超大图gnn的训练对算力和存储资源的要求是非常非常高的。而这种情况就是分布式gnn训练大显身手的好时机啦。分布式gnn训练是将输入图先进行partition并将工作负载分布在多台机器上。现有分布式GNN训练框架的关键瓶颈是对GNN的图数据和聚合算子(aggregation operator)的依赖性导致的跨机器通信(across-machine communication)。天空一声巨响,ABC(AGGREGATION BEFORE COMMUNICATION)闪亮登场。ABC提出了一种在分布式图神经网络训练中使用聚合而不是通信来减少通信量的框架,同时还提出了一种有效的分区方法。 1、ABC框架的好处是什么? ABC框架可以减少分布式图神经网络训练的通信开销,提高训练效率。该框架采用了聚合操作与通信步骤的重排序,可以在保证模型准确性的前提下减少通信复杂度。此外,ABC框架还显示出在动态图中表现良好的优点。 2、ABC框架是如何减少通信量的? ABC 框架利用GNN层的置换不变性(permutation invariant property),提出了一种简单的、无损的通信量减少方法。也就是ABC的全称【Aggregation Before Communication】“聚合后通信”。其核心思想是在通信之前对节点的特征进行聚合,减少通信时需要传输的数据量。 具体来说,ABC方法将聚合操作分解成可按任意顺序输入的子循环过程。它们在本地执行,并在通信之前将局部聚合结果传递到其他设备,这样可以减少数据传输的总量。ABC方法不仅可以保持通信的无损性,而且几乎没有额外的计算开销。 3、ABC框架对分布式图神经网络训练有哪些贡献? ABC框架提出了一种简单的、无损的通信减少方法,即“聚合操作先于通信”(顾名思义,Aggregation Before Communciation)。
results.title: 分布式GNN论文精读:ABC: AGGREGATION BEFORE COMMUNICATION

québec ai institute, hec montréal, canada bin cui, peking university, china lei chen, hong kong university of science and technology, china graph neural networks (gnns) are a type of deep learning models that learning over graphs, and have been successfully applied in many domains. despite the effectiveness of gnns, it is still challenging for gnns to efficiently scale to large graphs. as a remedy, distributed computing becomes a promising solution of training large-scale gnns, since it is able to provide abundant computing resources. however, the dependency of graph structure increases the difficulty of achieving high-efficiency distributed gnn training, which suffers from the massive communication and workload imbalance. in recent years, many efforts have been made on distributed gnn training, and an array of training algorithms and systems have been proposed. yet, there is a lack of systematic review on the optimization techniques from graph processing to distributed execution. in this survey, we analyze three major challenges in distributed gnn training that are massive feature communication, the loss of model accuracy and workload imbalance. then we introduce a new taxonomy for the optimization techniques in distributed gnn training that address the above challenges. the new taxonomy classifies existing techniques into four categories that are gnn data partition, gnn batch generation, gnn execution model, and gnn communication protocol. we carefully discuss the techniques in each category. in the end

raw_metadata.content: 论文地址:[2212.05410v1] ABC: Aggregation before Communication, a Communication Reduction Framework for Distributed Graph Neural Network Training and Effective Partition (arxiv.org) po主是一个小菜鸡,硕士毕业论文的研究方向是分布式gnn,这篇论文是副导的大作,本着看都看了就写篇笔记来总结的想法记录一下。我会尽量用平实的语言并且结合一些自己的理解,废话多说,下面开始进入正题。 众所周知,训练大图gnn是一个老难题了,因为去1:1还原现实生活中的web-scale graph是prohibitive的。(prohibitive一般被翻译为禁止的,但在这里也可以是高昂得令人难以承受的)超大图gnn的训练对算力和存储资源的要求是非常非常高的。而这种情况就是分布式gnn训练大显身手的好时机啦。分布式gnn训练是将输入图先进行partition并将工作负载分布在多台机器上。现有分布式GNN训练框架的关键瓶颈是对GNN的图数据和聚合算子(aggregation operator)的依赖性导致的跨机器通信(across-machine communication)。天空一声巨响,ABC(AGGREGATION BEFORE COMMUNICATION)闪亮登场。ABC提出了一种在分布式图神经网络训练中使用聚合而不是通信来减少通信量的框架,同时还提出了一种有效的分区方法。 1、ABC框架的好处是什么? ABC框架可以减少分布式图神经网络训练的通信开销,提高训练效率。该框架采用了聚合操作与通信步骤的重排序,可以在保证模型准确性的前提下减少通信复杂度。此外,ABC框架还显示出在动态图中表现良好的优点。 2、ABC框架是如何减少通信量的? ABC 框架利用GNN层的置换不变性(permutation invariant property),提出了一种简单的、无损的通信量减少方法。也就是ABC的全称【Aggregation Before Communication】“聚合后通信”。其核心思想是在通信之前对节点的特征进行聚合,减少通信时需要传输的数据量。 具体来说,ABC方法将聚合操作分解成可按任意顺序输入的子循环过程。它们在本地执行,并在通信之前将局部聚合结果传递到其他设备,这样可以减少数据传输的总量。ABC方法不仅可以保持通信的无损性,而且几乎没有额外的计算开销。 3、ABC框架对分布式图神经网络训练有哪些贡献? ABC框架提出了一种简单的、无损的通信减少方法,即“聚合操作先于通信”(顾名思义,Aggregation Before Communciation)。
